text:
Reading "everything on the plate" as the sushi only (4 pieces), I estimated each piece at roughly 30-35 g, which gives about 130 g total.

Sushi rolls (maki) with avocado, vegetables, and salmon or tuna come to roughly 1.4 kcal/g, so about 180 kcal.

I left out the ginger and wasabi, since they sit in separate cups and not on the plate.

{"kcal": 180, "mass_g": 130}
